Feature: System's self-containment and data privacy
  As a user, I want the system to be self-contained and not share any data with third parties
  My system should not share any data with external entities like Chemists and Labs

Scenario: Chemists log in and access prescriptions
  In order to access their prescriptions, Chemists should log in to the system
  Given the Chemist has valid credentials
  When they log in using the credentials
  Then they should see their own prescriptions without any third-party data

Scenario: Patients receive emails with prescriptions and invoice

  Given I have received a prescription
  And the system is configured to send emails
  When I request an email to be sent
  Then I should receive an email with the full prescription and invoice

Scenario: Payment interface with standard Payment Gateway
  As a patient, I want to use the standard Payment Gateway available with the Hospital
  Given the system integrates with the Payment Gateway
  When I choose to pay via Debit/Credit Cards or Net banking
  Then I should be redirected to a secure payment form

Scenario: Secure payment acceptance
  As a patient, I want to securely accept payments via Debit/Credit Cards or Net banking
  Given I am at the payment interface
  When I select a payment method
  Then the system should process the payment securely

# Test Suite for Requirement U24-3

Feature: System data isolation and user authentication
  Background: When a chemist or patient logs into the system, they should only access their own prescriptions and invoices
    Given a chemist or patient is authenticated and logged into the system
    And the system is using Django 2.0 with MySQL as the database
    And the system interface is compatible with Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Safari
    Then the system should only display their own prescriptions and invoices
    
    Scenario: Chemist accessing their own prescriptions and invoices
      | Input name (chemist credentials) | Expected result
      | Chemist credentials 1      | System displays chemist's own prescriptions and invoices
      | Chemist credentials 2      | System displays chemist's own prescriptions and invoices

    Scenario: Patient accessing their own prescriptions and invoices
      | Input name (patient credentials) | Expected result
      | Patient credentials 1      | System displays patient's own prescriptions and invoices
      | Patient credentials 2      | System displays patient's own prescriptions and invoices

Feature: Email communication to patients
  Background: The system should send emails to patients with their full prescription and invoice
  Background: The system uses MySQL for data storage and is compatible with standard browsers
  Background: The system interface is compatible with Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Safari
  Background: Only emails will be sent to patients
    Given a patient is authenticated and logged into the system
    And the patient has requested their prescription and invoice
    And the system is operational
    When the patient logs out
    Then the system should send an email with the full prescription and invoice

    Scenario: Patient logs in with valid credentials
      | Input name (valid credentials) | Expected result
      | Valid credentials 1      | Email with prescription and invoice sent
      | Valid credentials 2      | Email with prescription and invoice sent

    Scenario: Patient logs in with invalid credentials
      | Input name (invalid credentials) | Expected result
      | Invalid credentials 1    | Email not sent, and access denied
      | Invalid credentials 2    | Email not sent, and access denied

Feature: Payment processing interface
  Background: The system should provide a secure payment interface with Debit/Credit Cards and Net banking
  Background: The system interface is compatible with Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Safari
  Background: Only emails will be sent to patients
    Given a patient is authenticated and logged into the system
    And the patient requests payment
    And the payment interface is operational
    When the patient selects Debit/Credit Card or Net banking
    Then the system should enable a secure payment form

    Scenario: Patient selects Debit/Credit Card
      | Input card details | Expected result
      | Valid card details | Secure payment form enabled
      | Invalid card details | Error message, access denied

    Scenario: Patient selects Net banking
      | Input banking details | Expected result
      | Valid banking details | Secure payment form enabled
      | Invalid banking details | Error message, access denied

Feature: System data isolation and user authentication
  Background: The system should ensure no data sharing with third parties
  Background: The system uses Django 2.0 and MySQL
  Background: Only emails will be sent to patients
  Background: The system interface is compatible with Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Safari
  Background: The system should only enable access for authenticated chemists and patients
    Given a chemist or patient is not authenticated
    When they attempt to access the system
    Then they should be denied access

    Scenario: Unauthenticated chemist attempts access
      | Input name (chemist credentials) | Expected result
      | Chemist credentials 1      | Access denied
      | Chemist credentials 2      | Access denied

    Scenario: Unauthenticated patient attempts access
      | Input name (patient credentials) | Expected result
      | Patient credentials 1      | Access denied
      | Patient credentials 2      | Access denied
